name: math-hold-edges
description: Green-hold and streak edge cases (review round 2 on 2aa2dc0, re-review on abdc648). #11: a right answer typed within the wrong-answer flash keeps its glow. #2 + N4: Back during the last answer's hold records the round and leaves results at history depth 1. N2: in a 30-question race over 25 facts some facts repeat, and none moves its streak twice. N8: a Practice misses drill does not move the drilled fact's streak.

steps.label: a right answer 240ms after a wrong one keeps its green glow for the whole hold (review #11)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var a=ans();type(a===9?8:a+1);await sleep(240);type(ans());await sleep(200);return document.getElementById('card').classList.contains('ok')&&document.getElementById('answer').classList.contains('good');})()

steps.label: Back during the LAST answer's green hold records the round and shows results at the right history depth (review #2, re-review N4)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var n=0;while(document.getElementById('runCount').textContent!=='30 of 30'&&n<60){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}type(ans());await sleep(40);history.back();await sleep(700);var s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.sessions.pAva.v1')||'[]');return s.length===1&&!document.getElementById('resLayer').hidden&&history.state&&history.state.mathDepth===1;})()

steps.label: a fact asked twice in one workout moves its streak once (review #4 app wiring, re-review N2)
steps.js: (function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var f=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.facts.pAva.v1'));var ks=Object.keys(f);var twice=ks.filter(function(k){return f[k].n>=2&&f[k].miss===0;});var once=ks.filter(function(k){return f[k].miss===0;});return ks.length>=20&&twice.length>=1&&once.length>=20&&once.every(function(k){return f[k].ok===1;});})()

steps.label: Practice misses: the drilled fact's streak does not move (re-review N8)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var f0=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.facts.pAva.v1'));var missed=Object.keys(f0).filter(function(k){return f0[k].miss>0;});document.getElementById('drillBtn').click();await sleep(300);var n=0;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<10){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}var f=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.facts.pAva.v1'));return missed.length===1&&n===2&&f[missed[0]].n===f0[missed[0]].n+2&&f[missed[0]].ok===0;})()
